findings.priority_reason: Changes existing automatic command naming logic, which could break CLI expectations for users relying on inferred names from function names.
findings.title: Automatic Command Name Inference Includes Suffix Stripping
findings.before: The command name was derived by converting the function name to lowercase and replacing underscores with dashes.
findings.after: The command name logic now additionally strips specific suffixes (_command, _cmd, _group, _grp) from the end of the name after underscore-to-dash conversion.
findings.scenario: A command defined as 'def my_sync_command():' using @click.command() without an explicit name parameter.
findings.potential_impact: Existing CLI interfaces relying on full function-name-derived commands may change their invoked names, potentially breaking scripts or user muscle memory.
findings.review_question: Does stripping these suffixes align with the project's strategy for CLI usability, or does it introduce unexpected naming conflicts?

example.input: A command defined as 'def my_sync_command():' using @click.command() without an explicit name parameter.
